en.title: Practical Magic 2 Conjures $13 Million, Dethrones Spider-Man From Box Office Crown
en.summary: The Sanderson Sisters' magical return has officially cast its spell at the box office, with 'Practical Magic 2' casting aside 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' from its six-week reign. The highly anticipated sequel is poised for a massive opening weekend, proving that some magic is truly timeless.
en.body:
The witching hour has arrived at the domestic box office, and it's brought midnight margaritas. **Practical Magic 2**, the long-awaited sequel starring **Sandra Bullock** and **Nicole Kidman**, has stormed into theaters, conjuring an impressive $13 million on its opening Friday. This magical debut has successfully dethroned Sony's **Spider-Man: Brand New Day**, which had held the coveted No. 1 spot for a remarkable six consecutive weeks.

The original **Practical Magic**, released in 1998, became a cult classic, cherished for its blend of sisterly love, dark humor, and supernatural charm. Decades later, the Owens sisters are back, and their return is resonating strongly with fans who have eagerly awaited this continuation. The sequel's strong Friday performance sets it up for a powerful opening weekend, with projections aiming for a total debut between $30 million and $50 million. This success underscores the power of revisiting beloved characters and stories, especially when delivered with the right touch.

## The Spell of Nostalgia and Sisterhood

For six weeks, **Spider-Man: Brand New Day** swung through the box office charts, a testament to the superhero genre's continued dominance. However, the mystical allure of **Practical Magic 2** proved to be a potent counter-spell. The film's ability to capture the hearts of both original fans and potentially new audiences speaks volumes about its enduring appeal. The chemistry between Bullock and Kidman, alongside the promise of more magical mayhem, has clearly struck a chord. This isn't just about a sequel; it's about reconnecting with a story that means a great deal to a dedicated fanbase, proving that certain cinematic spells never fade.

## What's Next for the Owens Sisters

With **Practical Magic 2** now firmly in the lead, all eyes will be on its weekend performance to see if it can maintain its magical momentum. While **Spider-Man: Brand New Day** may be stepping down from the top spot, its impressive six-week run solidifies its place as a box office powerhouse. For fans of **Practical Magic**, this is a triumphant moment, and the box office numbers suggest the sisters' magic is far from over. We'll be watching closely to see how the final weekend numbers shape up and what this means for the future of magical cinema.
